behaviorChanges: the pre-push review-evidence + CI gates are skipped for a push whose FULL branch diff vs the configured base is entirely within the declared PM surfaces; code/mixed/ambiguous pushes and docs-only increments on branches that already carry code run the full gate (fail closed); authorized in canonical policy; operators must reinstall pre-push hooks to enable relief

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.10 restores the unconditional pre-push review/CI gate for every push (no PM-surface relief); no on-disk state moves in either direction.
